method: Read-only /proc process counters and diskstats, 60 process-state samples every 0.5 seconds; no added disk workload during source sample. Device counters cover all workloads on the shared source disk.
interpretation: At this observation window, STEP migration is predominantly waiting for source rotational-disk reads, not saturating compression/encryption CPU or the SSH link. The cumulative rsync progress speed reports uncompressed file bytes, not wire throughput. Network capacity needs a separate measurement.
whole_file_note: No existing destination basis exists for newly copied files; --whole-file does not avoid the dominant source directory/file reads on this initial transfer. No queue interruption was performed.
